posts.title: Video : Samuel L Jackson and the motherf*cking wind farms…
posts.description: Offshore wind is an underappreciated clean electricity source that is very much in its early stages. To accelerate its development, Swedish company Vattenfal has hired famous actor Samuel L Jackson to prop it up. It's the occasion for me to share some numbers on the global markets...
